question: In which directions should offerings be given to Kṣetrapāla and the Yoginī?
premises: An offering to Kṣetrapāla is associated with the west.
An offering to the Yoginī is associated with the south.
The verse prescribes giving these offerings.
inference: One should give the offering to Kṣetrapāla in the west and to the Yoginī in the south.
uncertainties: The object of giving is implied from the preceding offering context.
plain_english: One should give the offering to Kṣetrapāla in the west and to the Yoginī in the south.
